rubric.role_summary: Product Manager for a restaurant-technology hardware portfolio, managing product lifecycles, business cases, requirements, roadmaps, and cross-functional launches.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Product Manager for a restaurant-technology hardware portfolio, managing product lifecycles, business cases, requirements, roadmaps, and cross-functional launches.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of Product Management experience in hardware, technology, retail technology, hospitality technology, or related industries.
- Experience managing products through the full product lifecycle.
- Experience building business cases and product requirements.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with POS systems, restaurant technology, kiosks, mobility solutions, payments hardware, or enterprise hardware products.
- Experience with IOT products.
- Knowledge of manufacturing, supply chain, hardware development lifecycles, and quality processes.
- Experience working with ODM/OEM partners.
- Familiarity with financial modeling, pricing strategies, and product P&L management.
- MBA or advanced degree.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York State; Texas; Greater Philadelphia, Pennsylvania area; Florida; North Carolina; Minnesota; Colorado; Georgia; Illinois. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
